```python
def solution(n, m, segments, lengths):
    gaps = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(1, n)]
    bridge_used = [False] * m
    for i in range(m):
        bridge_length = lengths[i]
        for j in range(len(gaps)):
            if gaps[j][1] - gaps[j][0] >= bridge_length:
                bridge_used[i] = True
                gaps[j] = (gaps[j][0], gaps[j][0] + bridge_length - 1)
                break
        else:
            return "No"
    return "Yes"
```
